sources.title: Responsible Builder Policy
sources.excerpt: Any research that uses Reddit data collected outside of the RFR Program is in violation of this policy.
sources.review_note: Source-specific approval remains required for this project; do not equate public archive availability with authorization. This is a policy reading, not a legal opinion.

sources.title: Reddit for Researchers Program
sources.excerpt: Each monthly update incorporates the most recent content versions
sources.review_note: Institutional application, sponsorship and ethics documentation are needed. Current-version data does not alone establish original as-of text; clarification is necessary.

sources.title: Public Content Policy
sources.section: Reddit may license public content for commercial or non-commercial use
sources.excerpt: Ensure data licensees honor public content deletions by Redditors and Reddit.
sources.review_note: Respect applicable deletion obligations. A filtered historical sample must not be represented as an unchanged as-of information set.
